source.author: verg
source.text: nunc oblita mihi tot carmina; vox quoque Moerim iam fugit ipsa; lupi Moerim videre priores.
source.text_original: nunc oblita mihi tot carmina; vox quoque Moerim / iam fugit ipsa; lupi Moerim videre priores.
source.text_english: Now so many songs have slipped from my memory; even my voice itself has now fled from me, Moeris; the wolves saw Moeris first.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: unde et in alio loco idem poeta canit: omnia fert aetas, animum quoque et post modicum: nunc oblita mihi tot carmina, uox quoque Moerim iam fugit.
reuse.text_original: unde et in alio loco idem poeta canit: omnia fert aetas, animum quoque et post modicum: nunc oblita mihi tot carmina, uox quoque Moerim iam fugit.
reuse.text_english: Whence in another place the same poet sings: time carries all things away, the mind too, and after a little while: now so many songs have been forgotten by me, and voice itself has already fled from Moeris.
